description_en: Make a whole rainbow by mixing red, green, and blue light. Change the wavelength of a monochromatic beam or filter white light.
description_zh: 通过混合红、绿、蓝光制造彩虹。改变单色光束的波长或过滤白光。

content.en: Our eyes can see three main colors of light: red, green, and blue. When these colors mix together, they make all the other colors we see every day!
content.zh: 我们的眼睛能看到三种主要的光色：红色、绿色和蓝色。当这些颜色混合在一起时，就会变出我们每天看到的所有颜色！

content.en: When you mix red light and green light, you get yellow! Red and blue make pink (magenta). Green and blue make light blue (cyan). And all three together make white light!
content.zh: 当你把红光和绿光混在一起，就会变成黄色！红色和蓝色变成粉色。绿色和蓝色变成浅蓝色。三种光全部混在一起就变成白光！

content.en: Move the color sliders to mix different lights. Can you make your favorite color? Try making white light by turning all three colors to maximum!
content.zh: 移动颜色滑块来混合不同的光。你能调出你最喜欢的颜色吗？试试把三种颜色都调到最大，看看会变成什么！

curriculum_mappings.subject: 科学
curriculum_mappings.description: 三年级上册《光》单元：了解光的三原色和混合

curriculum_mappings.subject: 常识
curriculum_mappings.description: P3 General Studies: properties of light, mixing colors

description_en: An original interactive experience: explore how friction creates heat through story, prediction, simulation, and hands-on challenges!
description_zh: 原创互动体验：通过故事、预测、模拟和动手挑战，探索摩擦力如何产生热量！

content.en: Friction is what happens when two things rub together. Try rubbing your hands together quickly - do you feel them getting warm? That warmth comes from friction!
content.zh: 摩擦力就是两个东西互相摩擦时产生的力。试着快速搓搓你的双手——感觉到变暖了吗？那个热量就是摩擦产生的！

content.en: Everything around us is made of tiny tiny particles called atoms. When you rub things together, the atoms start shaking faster and faster. That shaking is what we feel as heat!
content.zh: 我们周围的一切都是由叫做"原子"的超小粒子组成的。当你摩擦东西时，原子会越抖越快。我们感觉到的热量就是原子在抖动！

content.en: Drag the top book back and forth. Watch the little atoms jiggle! Rub really fast and see what happens - can you make the atoms break free?
content.zh: 来回拖动上面的书。看看那些小原子在抖动！使劲快速摩擦，看看会发生什么——你能让原子挣脱出来吗？

curriculum_mappings.subject: 科学
curriculum_mappings.description: 三年级下册：认识摩擦力及其在生活中的作用

curriculum_mappings.subject: 科学
curriculum_mappings.description: 四年级上册：摩擦生热，热量的产生与传递

curriculum_mappings.subject: 常识
curriculum_mappings.description: P4 General Studies: forces in daily life, friction effects

description_en: Heat up or cool down atoms and watch them change between solid, liquid, and gas - just like ice, water, and steam!
description_zh: 给原子加热或冷却，观察它们在固态、液态和气态之间变化——就像冰、水和蒸气一样！

content.en: Everything around us can be a solid (like ice), a liquid (like water), or a gas (like steam). The tiny atoms inside behave differently in each form!
content.zh: 我们周围的一切都可以是固体（像冰）、液体（像水）或气体（像蒸气）。里面的小原子在每种形态下的表现都不一样！

content.en: In a solid, atoms stay in place and just wiggle a little. Add heat and they start moving more - that is melting! Add even more heat and they fly around everywhere - that is boiling!
content.zh: 在固体中，原子待在原地只是轻轻晃动。加热后它们开始移动更多——这就是融化！再加更多热量，它们就到处飞——这就是沸腾！

content.en: Press the heat button to warm things up. Watch the atoms start moving faster! Then cool it down and watch them slow down and freeze. Try different materials like water or oxygen!
content.zh: 按加热按钮让东西变暖。看原子动得越来越快！然后冷却它们，看它们慢下来并冻住。试试不同的材料，比如水或氧气！

curriculum_mappings.subject: 科学
curriculum_mappings.description: 三年级上册《水》单元：固态、液态、气态的变化

curriculum_mappings.subject: 科学
curriculum_mappings.description: 四年级上册：物质的状态变化与温度的关系

description_en: Play with objects on a seesaw to learn about balance! Can you figure out how to keep it level?
description_zh: 在跷跷板上放置物体来学习平衡！你能想出怎么让它保持水平吗？

content.en: On a seesaw, a heavy person sitting close to the middle can balance a lighter person sitting farther away. It is all about weight AND distance from the center!
content.zh: 在跷跷板上，一个重的人坐得离中间近，可以和一个轻的人坐得远的一边平衡。关键是重量和离中心的距离！

content.en: Put different objects on each side of the seesaw. Can you make it balance? Try the game mode and see if you can guess where to put things!
content.zh: 在跷跷板的两边放不同的东西。你能让它平衡吗？试试游戏模式，看看你能不能猜对该把东西放在哪里！

curriculum_mappings.subject: 科学
curriculum_mappings.description: 三年级下册：简单机械——杠杆原理，平衡条件

curriculum_mappings.subject: 数学
curriculum_mappings.description: 三年级：理解等量关系，为方程做准备

description_en: Use a balance scale to understand what "equal" really means. Put things on both sides and keep the scale level!
description_zh: 用天平来理解"相等"的到底是什么意思。在两边放东西，保持天平平衡！

content.en: When a balance scale is perfectly level, both sides have the same weight. That is what "equal" means - the two sides are the same!
content.zh: 当天平完全水平时，两边的重量一样。这就是"相等"的意思——两边是一样的！

content.en: If you add something to one side, you need to add the same thing to the other side to keep it balanced. This is the most important rule!
content.zh: 如果你在一边加了东西，你也需要在另一边加上一样的东西来保持平衡。这是最重要的规则！

content.en: Drag objects onto both sides of the scale. Can you keep it balanced? Try the "Solve It!" game to practice finding the mystery number!
content.zh: 把物体拖到天平的两边。你能保持平衡吗？试试"解题"游戏来练习找出神秘数字！

curriculum_mappings.subject: 数学
curriculum_mappings.description: 三年级：理解等式概念，天平模型

curriculum_mappings.subject: 数学
curriculum_mappings.description: 四年级：用天平模型理解方程的含义

description_en: Watch a skater zoom up and down on tracks! See how speed and height are connected through energy.
description_zh: 看滑板选手在轨道上飞驰！了解速度和高度是怎么通过能量联系在一起的。

content.en: When the skater is high up, they have stored energy (like a stretched rubber band). As they roll down, that stored energy turns into speed energy. Higher up means faster at the bottom!
content.zh: 当滑板选手在高处时，他有储存的能量（就像拉伸的橡皮筋）。当他往下滑时，储存的能量变成了速度能量。起点越高，到底部就越快！

content.en: Energy cannot just vanish! It changes form: height energy becomes speed energy, and speed energy becomes height energy. Watch the colored bars to see this happen!
content.zh: 能量不会凭空消失！它会变换形式：高度能量变成速度能量，速度能量又变回高度能量。看看彩色的柱状图就能看到这个过程！

content.en: Put the skater at the top of the ramp and let go. Watch the energy bars change! Try turning on friction - where does the energy go then?
content.zh: 把滑板选手放在坡道顶部然后放手。看看能量柱状图的变化！试试打开摩擦力——那能量去哪里了呢？

curriculum_mappings.subject: 科学
curriculum_mappings.description: 四年级下册：能量的形式和转换

description_en: Explore basic electricity relationships. Build circuits with batteries, resistors, light bulbs, and switches.
description_zh: 探索基本的电学关系。用电池、电阻、灯泡和开关搭建电路。

content.en: An electric circuit is a closed loop through which electric current can flow. It needs a power source (like a battery), a load (like a light bulb), and wires to connect them.
content.zh: 电路是电流可以流过的闭合回路。它需要电源（如电池）、负载（如灯泡）和连接它们的导线。

content.en: Voltage (V) = Current (I) x Resistance (R). This fundamental law describes how voltage, current, and resistance relate to each other in a circuit.
content.zh: 电压（V）= 电流（I）x 电阻（R）。这个基本定律描述了电路中电压、电流和电阻之间的关系。

content.en: Drag components from the toolbox to build a circuit. Connect a battery to a light bulb and watch it glow. Try adding resistors to see how brightness changes.
content.zh: 从工具箱中拖动元件来搭建电路。将电池连接到灯泡并观察它发光。试着添加电阻，看看亮度如何变化。

curriculum_mappings.subject: 科学
curriculum_mappings.description: 四年级下册《电》单元：简单电路的组成，串联与并联

curriculum_mappings.subject: 常识
curriculum_mappings.description: P5 General Studies: simple circuits, conductors and insulators

description_en: Move the sun, earth, moon and space station to see how it affects their gravitational forces and orbital paths.
description_zh: 移动太阳、地球、月球和空间站，观察引力和轨道路径如何变化。

content.en: Every object with mass attracts every other object with mass. The force depends on both masses and the distance between them.
content.zh: 每个有质量的物体都会吸引其他有质量的物体。引力取决于两个物体的质量和它们之间的距离。

content.en: Try changing the mass of the Earth or Sun. See what happens to the orbit when you increase the velocity.
content.zh: 试着改变地球或太阳的质量。看看当你增加速度时轨道会发生什么变化。

curriculum_mappings.subject: 科学
curriculum_mappings.description: 三年级下册：太阳系行星运动

description_en: Explore the wonderful world of waves! Observe a string vibrate in slow motion.
description_zh: 探索奇妙的波动世界！以慢动作观察绳子的振动。

content.en: A wave is a disturbance that transfers energy from one place to another without transferring matter.
content.zh: 波是一种将能量从一个地方传递到另一个地方而不传递物质的扰动。

content.en: Use the slider to change the frequency and amplitude. Switch between manual, oscillate, and pulse modes.
content.zh: 使用滑块来改变频率和振幅。在手动、振荡和脉冲模式之间切换。

curriculum_mappings.subject: 科学
curriculum_mappings.description: 四年级上册《声音》单元：声音的产生与传播，振动

description_en: Build an atom out of protons, neutrons, and electrons, and see how the element, charge, and mass change.
description_zh: 用质子、中子和电子构建一个原子，观察元素、电荷和质量如何变化。

content.en: Atoms are made of three subatomic particles: protons (positive charge), neutrons (no charge), and electrons (negative charge).
content.zh: 原子由三种亚原子粒子组成：质子（正电荷）、中子（无电荷）和电子（负电荷）。

content.en: Drag protons, neutrons, and electrons into the atom. Watch how the element name, charge, and mass number change.
content.zh: 将质子、中子和电子拖到原子中。观察元素名称、电荷和质量数如何变化。

description_en: Hang masses from springs and adjust the spring constant and damping.
description_zh: 在弹簧上悬挂质量块，调节弹簧常数和阻尼。

content.en: The force exerted by a spring is proportional to how far it is stretched: F = -kx.
content.zh: 弹簧施加的力与其拉伸的距离成正比：F = -kx。

content.en: Hang different masses on the springs. Change the spring constant and observe how stiffness affects the oscillation.
content.zh: 在弹簧上悬挂不同的质量。改变弹簧常数，观察刚度如何影响振荡。

curriculum_mappings.subject: 科学
curriculum_mappings.description: 三年级下册：弹簧与弹力，力的大小

description_en: Blast a car out of a cannon, and challenge yourself to hit a target!
description_zh: 用大炮发射汽车，挑战自己击中目标！

content.en: A projectile moves in two independent directions: horizontally and vertically.
content.zh: 抛体在两个独立方向上运动：水平方向和竖直方向。

content.en: Change the angle and initial speed. Try enabling air resistance.
content.zh: 改变角度和初始速度。尝试启用空气阻力。

description_en: Stimulate a neuron and watch what happens. Observe the ions as they move across the neuron membrane.
description_zh: 刺激一个神经元并观察发生了什么。观察离子穿过神经元细胞膜的过程。

content.en: A neuron is a nerve cell that transmits electrical signals throughout the body.
content.zh: 神经元是一种通过全身传输电信号的神经细胞。

content.en: Click the "Stimulate Neuron" button to trigger an action potential.
content.zh: 点击"刺激神经元"按钮触发一个动作电位。

description_en: Explore natural selection by controlling the environment and observing how populations of bunnies evolve over time.
description_zh: 通过控制环境来探索自然选择，观察兔子种群如何随时间演化。

content.en: Natural selection is the process where organisms with traits better suited to their environment survive and reproduce more.
content.zh: 自然选择是指具有更适应环境特征的生物能够更好地生存和繁殖的过程。

content.en: Add a mutation for fur color or teeth. Then change the environment.
content.zh: 添加毛色或牙齿的突变。然后改变环境。
